Kanwar Yatra Disrupts Traffic, Authorities Issue Advisories

Authorities have issued traffic advisories and implemented diversions in Delhi, Gurugram, and Ghaziabad ahead of the Kanwar Yatra. The Delhi-Meerut Expressway's Meerut-Ghaziabad stretch is restricted for vehicles. Heavy vehicles face restrictions in Delhi until August 11, with advisories suggesting alternative routes like Dwarka and KMP expressways. Residents in Delhi have reported issues with noise from boomboxes and worsening traffic conditions due to the yatra.
